title: Automatic topic labelling of pull requests to Physlib
summary: Adapted Mathlib's autolabel script to Physlib, and wrote the GitHub workflow that runs it whenever a pull request is opened. The script reads which files a pull request changes and, if exactly one topic label fits, the workflow adds it. The script also checks that every folder in Physlib and QuantumInfo is covered by a label, and flags any new folders not covered by a label.
